content:
A successful new payment does not automatically cancel, replace or deduplicate older transfers with the same obligation reference. Fees in fee_balance_minor and principal in balance_minor are different balances and must be reported separately.

A PROCESSING payment is not a settled contribution to the recipient obligation. A CNY withdrawal has its own recipient, currency and final settlement receipt.
